author: RIP_Avicus
body:
Hey guys,
I was thinking today about how Nebula has 3 main game modes (DTM, TDM and CTW) and I thought that control/capture points might be a cool thing to add.
You could incorporate things from DTM like defense and they could make for really good games.
If you had around 5-7 points and your team accumulated a certain amount of points a second for how many points they has control of, (e.g. 1 point = 100 p/sec, 2 points = 200 p/sec) and there would be a target of how many points a team had to get.
Once you had controlled a point, you could have defenders to make it harder for the other team to capture, or you could have maps where no building is allowed.
Feedback would be greatly appreciated :D
